name: Mauritius
description: Mauritius from an empty island and the dodo to Dutch, French and British rule, Indian labourers, independence in 1968 and a stable democracy.

checkpoints.name: Dutch and French
checkpoints.note: The Dutch named the island in 1598, and the dodo was gone by 1662. France ran it as Isle de France from 1715.

checkpoints.name: British Mauritius
checkpoints.note: Britain took the island in 1810. After slavery ended, labourers came from India.

checkpoints.name: Independent Mauritius
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1968. Mauritius became one of Africa's richest democracies.
